lines: [sly] [fast] One billion dollars. Spend a hundred grand a day.
[fast] A hundred thousand. Every single day. Cars, jets, whatever.
[confident] Spoiler: you never run out. Ever.
[deadpan] Park the billion somewhere boring. Four percent a year.
[shocked] That's forty million a year. A hundred and nine thousand a day.
[smug] You spend a hundred. The billion makes a hundred and nine.
[happy] Every year you end up richer than you started.
[whisper] So... one billion. A hundred grand a day.
